D05_library: So this is where you hide after class.
What's the book about? Give me the short version.
This handwriting in the margin — is that yours?
Wait. The kid in chapter two did the same thing I did at lunch.
You knew my name before I told you, didn't you.
Say my name. Just once, so I know you remember it.
Okay. I'll take the book. Walk me out?
D07_aquarium: You weren't kidding. It's quiet in here.
Which one's your favourite? They all look like floating plastic bags.
Do they know we're watching them?
You keep looking at the glass, not the fish.
Have you ever been on the other side of the glass?
Hey. You're doing that thing where your sentences go somewhere else.
If you were in the tank, would you want me to get you out?
The place is closing. We should go.
D08_summer_festival: You tied that yukata yourself? It's not falling apart. I'm impressed.
Okay, goldfish first. Then you owe me a rabbit.
You already got the rabbit? When did you—
Where is everyone? The stalls were full a minute ago.
The fireworks stopped. That's not how fireworks work.
Hey. Don't grab my sleeve so hard.
I'm not leaving. I'm right here.
Let's watch the last one together. Then we go home.
D09_beach_sunset: The tide's out. That means we have, what, an hour?
You're building it too neat. Castles are supposed to look accidental.
The moat's leaking. I'm declaring an emergency.
You're writing my name on it? Now the sea's going to be jealous.
The sun's basically touching the water.
You're quiet. Not a bad quiet, just... quiet.
We should head back before it gets cold.
D10_ferris_wheel: I didn't know you were scared of heights.
Just don't look down. Look at me.
You said you had something to tell me.
Take your time. We've got the whole ride.
The wheel stopped. Is that normal?
Hey — you're holding the rail pretty hard.
We can get someone to let us down, it's fine.
I'm not going anywhere. Say what you were going to say.
D12_cooking_together: I didn't know the home-ec room was open. This is a lot of flour.
What are we making? Please don't say 'surprise.'
Okay, what's the secret ingredient? You've been weird about it.
That's not an ingredient. That's a threat.
I'm eating it. Look, I'm eating it.
Seriously, it's good. Why are you looking at me like that?
I02_love_letter: A letter? People don't write letters anymore.
You want me to read it now?
Okay, but don't watch me read it.
This line — did you mean it, or did it just sound nice?
There's more on the back. It keeps going.
I don't know what to say. I liked it. I did.
I03_quiz_about_her: A quiz? Is there a prize, or just humiliation?
Favourite colour. Blue. Wait, you said red last time—
You're writing down my answers? That's cheating.
Okay: what are you afraid of? Heights? Being forgotten?
That was two answers ago. Why are you reading it back to me?
I think I passed. I get the prize now, right?
I05_poem: You wrote me a poem? Okay. I'm listening.
Read it slow. I'm not good with poems.
The rain, the aquarium — I was there for both of those.
Wait. The first letters. Say that again.
What is it spelling? Don't turn the page.
The last word is the same one every time. What does it mean?
I08_rival_appears: Aya said hi. We had a class together last year.
Why are you standing back there?
She just asked about the homework. That's all.
Don't say her name like that.
I'm talking to you now, aren't I?
I13_lucid_moment: Take your breath. I'm not going anywhere.
What did you notice? Describe it.
You're here. Count with me. Ten, nine...
Write it down? Okay. I'm writing. Keep talking.
I15_promise: A promise? That's a serious face.
Okay. I promise I'll come back tomorrow.
You want me to say it again? Fine: I'll come back.
What's the fourth promise? You said four.
That one's too much. You know I can't promise that.
SP_YANDERE_the_list: What's on the paper? You've been holding it all evening.
Those are names. Why do you have names?
Aya? She's my friend. Why is she on there?
Stop crossing them out. Look at me.
There's my name at the top. Why am I at the top?
